title: Automatic VPAT Generator Tool – Simplify Accessibility
description: Generate VPATs automatically with our tool to ensure web accessibility compliance. Save time, reduce errors, and streamline accessibility reporting today.
body:
# VPAT Generator (ACR Automation Tool)

### A highefficiency automation solution for generating Accessibility Conformance Reports (ACRs) from structured accessibility issue data.

The VPAT Generator is an internal automation tool developed by our team to streamline the creation of Accessibility Conformance Reports (ACRs)/VPATs. Built to reduce manual effort, improve reporting accuracy, and standardize documentation, this tool enables rapid conversion of accessibility issue datasets into leadershipready compliance reports with clear metrics and structured summaries. By combining automated data extraction, rulebased mapping logic, and standardized output generation, the VPAT Generator enhances our delivery efficiency and ensures consistent accessibility reporting across engagement types.

## Core Capabilities

### Automated VPAT Generation

Designed to transform structured accessibility issue data into complete, standardsaligned conformance reports without manual intervention.

What it offers:

Imports accessibility issue data directly from structured Excel workbooks

Structured Data Extraction & Mapping

Generates standardized VPAT outputs with conformance status and remarks

Produces complete Accessibility Conformance Reports (ACRs) quickly and consistently

Eliminates repetitive manual report creation steps

This capability ensures reliable, repeatable reporting with minimal manual effort.

### Developer & Path-Based Accessibility Scanner

Automates extraction of key accessibility data and aligns it with reporting requirements.

What it offers:

Reads reporting sheet and all associated issue sheets from Excel

Matches WCAG criteria across sheets for accurate data alignment

Extracts issue details including page/component, severity, steps to reproduce, and recommendations

Applies clear mapping logic for remarks and conformance assignments

### Conformance Summary Statistics

Delivers quantitative compliance insights that support decisionmaking and leadership visibility.

Calculates total counts for each conformance level

Generates overall compliance scores based on applicable criteria

Computes percentage distributions with precision (rounded to two decimals)

Presents structured summaries in an executiveready summary sheet

These statistics provide clarity into coverage, trends, and overall accessibility posture.

Standardized Output & Template Support

Generates reports using consistent templates for clarity and governanceready documentation.

Automatically populates a standard VPAT template with conformance results

Includes remarks, issue descriptions, and standardized responses for “Not Applicable” criteria

Produces outputs that are ready for leadership review and client communication

Maintains consistency across multiple reporting cycles

Reporting Standards Coverage

The VPAT Generator aligns reporting with recognized accessibility criteria:

WCAG 2.1 WCAG 2.2 — Conformance levels mapped

Standard VPAT template conventions for accessibility documentation

Structured remarks tied to issue details and criteria

Reporting & Insights

Integrated into internal accessibility reporting workflows

Designed to work with standardized Excel workbooks from testing tools

Generates outputs compatible with internal review and leadership reporting

Supports future enhancement paths including additional templates and formats

The tool enhances our internal reporting capabilities without disrupting existing processes.

#### Who It’s For

The VPAT Generator supports teams and workflows that require efficient, accurate accessibility reporting

- 1. Accessibility & Compliance TeamsAutomated conformance report delivery
- 2. Project Managers & Delivery LeadsRapid insights for status tracking
- 3. Developers & QA EngineersStructured mapping from test outputs to reports
- 4. Executive StakeholdersStandardized, metricsdriven summaries

### Why VPAT Generator (ACR Automation Tool)

Our internal VPAT Generator is a key capability that enhances how we deliver accessibility conformance insights — enabling faster turnaround, better accuracy, and repeatable outcomes.

Automated Report Production — eliminates manual VPAT creation

Consistent Outputs — standardized and leadershipready documentation

Accurate Mapping — structured extraction and criteria alignment

Quantitative Insights — compliance percentages and breakdowns

Efficiency Gains — reduces effort and accelerates accessibility reporting

### Future Enhancements (Planned)

Support for multiple report templates (Word / PDF)

Additional standards (508, EN 301 549)

Automated distribution and delivery of reports

Dashboards and visual analytics for leadership insights

These enhancements will expand the tool’s capabilities and support broader reporting needs.
